puzzles.description: Tap the steps in order to build the complaints pipeline for files.

items.label: Iceberg table on S3 for storage

hints: Start with the files, ingest them, store them, then query them.
AWS Glue ingests the raw files and stores them as an open Iceberg table on S3. Athena queries that table.
Raw source files → AWS Glue for ingestion → Iceberg table on S3 for storage → Amazon Athena for querying.

puzzles.description: Drag each item into the right section of the dataset listing, then publish it.
hints: Each section answers a question for whoever finds this dataset: what is it, is it sensitive, where did it come from, who can see it?
PII is the sensitive-data label. Lineage shows where the data came from. Access says who can see it, with citizen details masked.
Description: Monthly totals. Glossary term: PII. Lineage: From case DB. Access: Analysts, masked.
